I will keep this bean plot simple because it is only 0.39 hectares, and I do not like spending cash where I am not sure I will get it back. On beans, I will use the seed I know and I will put manure if I have enough at home, because this land is mine and manure helps without needing much cash. I will depend on the rains here in Mzimba, and I will use family work for most of it, only calling a little hired help if work comes all at once.
